chain.subject: Select edge-minimal C4 proving source set
chain.what_the_document_was_about: Selection of an edge-minimal proving source set. The vocabulary it introduces is a WORKLOAD TIER taxonomy, not an I/O contract.

decisive_content.workload_tiers.bounded_physical_edge_wit: SRC02 G01 user-missing representation; SRC06 G01 observed representation; SRC08 D01 BIG5; SRC12 D01 WINDOWS-1252; SRC14 D02 opaque date/time; SRC26 R05 header/dictionary divergence

chain.significance: The FIRST authoritative use of PHYSICAL is as a member of a tier pair: 'bounded_physical_edge_witness' versus 'full_route_empirical_anchor'. Each bounded physical source exists to witness exactly ONE narrow representational property. PHYSICAL therefore denotes the evidence/access TIER, not an I/O granularity.

chain.subject: PYAT C4B: freeze workload authority oracle custody and D02
chain.significance: The tier vocabulary is carried into the freeze unchanged as read_economy. semantic_route_status is NOT_SELECTED_AS_SEMANTIC_ROUTE_ANCHOR for all six bounded physical sources, versus real semantic authority for SRC27/SRC35. This is the explicit PHYSICAL-versus-SEMANTIC contrast.

chain.subject: C4 executable freeze fan-in
chain.significance: The trailing _ONLY is dropped at exactly the moment numeric read counters appear. READ_ONLY became READ plus a counted budget. The _ONLY was never a byte qualifier; it marked that ONLY a read occurs (no retention, pooling or semantic production).

chain.subject: Alt-B independent review: C4 executable freeze APPROVE_AT_DECLARED_GRAIN
chain.significance: The review that APPROVED expected_selected_reads=1 / expected_full_reads=0 performed presence-and-consistency checking only. It recorded the values and their provenance but never asked what a selected-column read is at the measurement layer. The term was therefore never authoritatively defined at approval time.

chain.subject: HQ190-C R9 warrant per-access-layer accounting binding successor candidate
chain.significance: Grades ACC-07_selected_reads as E (exact value 1) while grading ACC-09_byte_counts as '—' (no value exists anywhere). Two sibling accounts of the same operation, one valued and one not, is only coherent if a selected read is NOT defined by its byte traffic.

term_lineage_summary.PHYSICAL: tier / proof-mode / evidence-class, contrasted with full-route and with semantic routes

term_lineage_summary.expected_selected_reads: introduced by C4 as a numeric reader-invocation budget; never defined in prose
